arguments.summary: The repository has serious CI/CD security flaws (pull_request_target misuse, script injection, write-all permissions), incorrect CI branch triggers, masked test failures, hardcoded credentials in git history, and configuration/dependency inconsistencies.

violations.recommendation: Avoid using pull_request_target with head.sha checkout and execution of untrusted scripts; use pull_request instead or do not execute PR-authored code with secrets.
violations.evidence:
- uses: actions/checkout@v4
  with:
    ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
...
  run: |
    pip install -r requirements.txt
    python scripts/publish_preview.py
violations.description: pull_request_target workflow checks out untrusted PR head code and executes a script from it with secrets and write-all permissions.

violations.recommendation: Pass untrusted event data via environment variables instead of direct shell interpolation.
violations.description: Potential script injection via untrusted event data interpolated directly into run command.
Overly broad write-all token permissions granted to the workflow.
violations.recommendation: Grant only the minimum required permissions (e.g., contents: read).
